shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200

cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && cat src/App.tsx && echo ---- && cat src/main.tsx && echo ---- && cat src/vite-env.d.ts && echo ---- && cat index.html && echo ---- && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50 && echo ---- && grep -n -i -C 3 'i18n\|locale\|translation' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

sed -n 300,340p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60 && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ----; grep -n '"@gravity-ui/i18n"' package-lock.json | head; echo ----; grep -rn "gravity-ui/i18n" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; echo ----; rg -n "export (declare )?(function|const) configure|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -ln "configure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -20

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "configure|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.js; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -120; echo ----; grep -rn "subscribeConfigure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.js | head; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build | head

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm | head -30; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json | node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0));console.log(p.main,p.module,p.types,p.exports)'; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | tr '\n' ' '

rg -n -A12 "interface ControlGroupProps|interface ControlGroupOption" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "Text|Flex|Card|Button|SegmentedRadioGroup|ThemeProvider" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts

npm install @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -5; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json').version"; git diff --stat; echo ----; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"

rg -n "direction|justifyContent|alignItems|wrap|gap" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -12; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/ ; echo ----; rg -n "color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -8; echo ----; rg -n "padding" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css | head -5; echo ----; rg -n "aria-label" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -3; echo ----; rg -n "types" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "export type StringWithSuggest" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/types.d.ts

rg -n "TEXT_COLORS\s*=" -A 12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.js | head -20; echo ----; grep -rn "ControlGroupOption" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "export \* from \"./types" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "padding" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.js | head -5; echo; grep -n "padding" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/*.css | head -5
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -30; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
ls node_modules | grep -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$"; node --version; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(vitest|tsx)$"
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff -- package.json && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK
